source_text: Salvare animam tuam; noli respicere. Uxor in statuam salis — amor praeteritorum. Segor parva — modicus profectus salvus.
pass_a_gloss: To-save soul your; do-not look-back. Wife into statue of-salt — love of-past-things. Zoar small — modest progress safe.
